scenarios.name: Hero Section Display and Content
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with all required elements including headline, tagline, description, and call-to-action buttons

steps.description: Load the MirDB product homepage in a browser
steps.context: Clean browser session with no cache

steps.description: Check that the bold headline 'MirDB: Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm the subheadline explaining the core value proposition is present
steps.context: Content should convey the 'painless as using memcached' messaging

steps.description: Check that primary CTA 'Get Started' and secondary CTA 'View on GitHub' buttons are displayed
steps.context: Buttons should be visually distinct and clickable

test_cases.expected: Hero section visible with headline containing 'MirDB' and 'Persistent Key-Value Store'
H1 tag present with correct headline text
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'View Documentation' is clickable
Button/link with text 'View on GitHub' linking to https://github.com/yetone/mirdb

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases 4-6 key product features with visual representations

steps.description: Navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be clearly visible and well-organized

steps.description: Confirm that 4-6 key features are displayed
steps.context: Features should include: Memcached Compatible, Persistent Storage, High Performance, LSM Tree Architecture, Skip List Memtable, Automatic Compaction

steps.description: Check that each feature has an associated visual icon or illustration
steps.context: Icons should be meaningful and relevant to each feature

steps.description: Confirm each feature has a title and description
steps.context: Descriptions should be concise and informative

test_cases.input: Count feature items in features section
test_cases.expected: Between 4 and 6 feature items displayed
Feature card with title containing 'Memcached' and description about drop-in replacement
Feature card mentioning SSTable-based disk persistence
Each feature item contains an img or svg element
Feature card mentioning Rust and/or Tokio async I/O

scenarios.name: Code Example Section
scenarios.description: Verify the code example section demonstrates memcached protocol usage correctly

steps.description: Scroll to or identify the code example/demo section
steps.context: Section should showcase memcached protocol commands

steps.description: Check that code is displayed in a formatted code block with syntax highlighting
steps.context: Code should be readable and properly formatted

steps.description: Confirm the code example shows telnet commands, set, get operations
steps.context: Should demonstrate basic key-value operations via memcached protocol

test_cases.expected: Pre or code element with memcached command examples present
Code contains 'set mykey' or similar set command
Code contains 'get mykey' or similar get command
Code shows 'STORED' response after set command
Code includes 'telnet localhost 12333' or similar connection command

steps.context: Section should be easy to find and follow

steps.description: Check that git clone command is provided

steps.description: Check that cargo build command is provided
steps.context: Should include --release flag for production build

steps.description: Check that server run command is provided
steps.context: Should show how to start mirdb-server

test_cases.expected: Command 'git clone https://github.com/yetone/mirdb.git' present
Command 'cargo build --release' or 'cargo build' present
Command showing './target/release/mirdb-server' or similar execution

test_cases.input: Verify commands are in code blocks
test_cases.expected: All commands displayed in pre/code elements with proper formatting

steps.description: Navigate entire page using only keyboard
steps.context: All interactive elements should be reachable via Tab

steps.description: Check that all images have appropriate alt attributes
steps.context: Decorative images can have empty alt

steps.description: Verify visible focus indicators on interactive elements
steps.context: Focus should be clearly visible when tabbing

test_cases.expected: No critical or serious accessibility violations
All buttons and links reachable via keyboard

test_cases.input: Check all images for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All img elements have alt attribute
All text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 minimum)
Visible focus ring on all interactive elements when focused
Icon-only buttons have aria-label or screen reader text
